However, an external evaluation cohort of N=1 cannot support meaningful classification metrics (MCC/AUROC/AUPRC) or balanced positive/negative class coverage across both tasks. Therefore, in strict accordance with protocol-amd-03, research_status.json MUST remain blocked.
